name: White Runtz Cartridge | 1g
description: This indica/sativa hybrid is the intersection of Gelato and Zkittles. It’s euphoric, happy and relaxed feelings with it’s sweet and fruity flavoring will leave the consumer in a happy cloud. It’s crystallized trichomes present a diamond-like shine.
